quarantined_leads.lead: Brazos County detention officer Dwayne Andre Richards was arrested by College Station Police on charges of family-violence assault involving impeding breath or circulation and interfering with an emergency call; the Brazos County Sheriff's Office suspended him pending an internal investigation.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Brazos County Detention Officer Arrested in College Station
quarantined_leads.subject_response: The Brazos County Sheriff's Office said it expects professionalism, accountability, and integrity from everyone serving with the office. No direct response from Richards was located.
quarantined_leads.reason: The report identifies a covered corrections/law-enforcement role and attributes the arrest and suspension to College Station Police and the Brazos County Sheriff's Office, but only one reputable report was located and no direct official arrest or suspension record was accessible in this sweep. The criminal allegations remain unresolved; retain for corroboration and do not publish as a conviction or established fact.
